$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-popover__content) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer. header is the header slot, header#1 the title-and-description frame inside it; content is the content slot.

root.$why: The border is outside the box in Figma, drawn as an outer 1 px shadow before the Surface/Popover shadow. Figma's root is a vertical auto-layout with no padding or gap; code stacks the header and the body in a flex column.

header.$why: Figma's header slot is a horizontal auto-layout holding one frame, so its 12 px gap never shows; code's header is the title-and-description column itself.

header#1.$why: The title-and-description frame inside the slot; in code they sit directly in the header, which carries the slot's padding.

Actions.$why: Hugs the buttons in Figma; code's row spans the body (the buttons keep their widths).
